data.title: Verdict: AcmeDB Walks Into the Courtroom Sweating
data.subject: AcmeDB
data.take: the boring database that actually ships
data.summary: AcmeDB does ONE thing — durable key-value storage — and it just does it, no operator PhD required, no blood sacrifice to the infrastructure gods. No consensus wizardry, no sharding astrology, just a WAL, a manifest, and docs that answer the question you actually asked, which should not be revolutionary and yet HERE WE ARE.

receipts.evidence: vendor benchmark on a laptop, not replicated
the docs list snapshots as 'coming soon'

data.bottom_line: Ship it behind a cache, absolutely. But your crown jewels? NOT in this thing, keep those somewhere with a pulse.
caveats: We did not run our own benchmark. The latency number is theirs, not ours.
Checked against the docs on the date above. Roadmaps move.
